# Field-Service Estimate Engine

Problem: A contractor or service operator needs a consistent estimate/range from scope and measurements, with transparent cost build-up, margin assumptions and uncertainty rather than a hand-waved price.
Pricing: No approved external machine price/payment path was found. Internal service-template prices/cost assumptions are estimation inputs, not the price of this machine capability.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=eps-estimate-engine-machine-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=eps-estimate-engine-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- estimate this service job
- build a contractor estimate from this scope
- what should this job cost
- turn these measurements into an estimate
- give me a rough customer range
- calculate margin and price for this job

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
